method: Enumerate every visible research/* branch entry before candidate selection.
Deep-read branches with theorem/result/proposal/verifier artifacts and mechanisms not already subsumed by the 2026-09-19 cross-repo harvest.
Prefer sealed theorem/result artifacts over branch names or speculative journals.
Check nearest public prior art for every high-priority mechanism before assigning any distinctiveness status.
Do not infer historical novelty from absence in a limited literature search.

strongest_new_finding.name: DUAL_DEBT_PROOF_STATE_LIFECYCLE_KERNEL
strongest_new_finding.observation: The current Projected Semantic Debt Kernel tracks reconstruction obligations, but older MK-BCEG R3/R4 already tracked a different liability: exact transformations/queries that are deferred or representation switches whose future cost/certification is not yet discharged. These should be unified rather than treated as separate experiments.

combined_state_extension.semantic_debt: Which original witness obligations have been projected away but are not yet reconstructibly certified.
combined_state_extension.transformation_debt: Which exact operations/queries have been deferred because the current representation cannot execute them under a certified cheap route.
combined_state_extension.verification_liability: Future verification/certification work already incurred by a chosen representation or transition and forbidden from disappearing through a semantic roundtrip.
combined_state_extension.discovery_liability: Charged proof-language/route/candidate discovery work, including failed candidates, required before a discharge may support a complexity claim.
combined_state_extension.capability_profile: Exact operation set and complexity/certificate status supported by the current representation.
combined_state_extension.historical_receipts: Immutable chain proving how meaning, representation, capabilities, costs, debts and liabilities changed.

historical_repo_evidence.key_mechanism: Execute/switch only along operation-language routes with explicit capability status, translation cost and verification cost; UNKNOWN or outstanding debt blocks polynomial promotion.

known_overlap: Knowledge Compilation Map already analyzes representation languages by succinctness plus supported polynomial-time queries and transformations.
Closure/forgetting literature studies existential quantification and operation closure of compilation languages.
Amortized analysis already provides liability/potential accounting across operation sequences.
Certified projected knowledge compilation already certifies projection plus Skolem reconstruction.
nearest_prior_art.distinctive_residue_candidate: A runtime proof-carrying state that simultaneously carries exact meaning, representation-specific operation capabilities, reconstruction debt, deferred-transformation debt, verification/discovery liabilities, immutable transition provenance, and fail-closed switching authority. The current sweep did not identify a standard SAT/BFS/QBF architecture exposing this full combined contract as the solver state.

potential_algorithmic_advantage: Choose representation by the future operation trajectory, not merely present compactness.
Reject a representation switch before materialization when a certified lower bound/capability receipt already shows it will exceed the authorized envelope.
Permit deferred exact operations without pretending the future work vanished.
Prevent repeated language switching from laundering cumulative complexity.
Let a scheduler optimize routes while immutable receipts preserve exact authority.

high_priority_candidates.name: CAPABILITY_SCOPED_PROOF_CARRYING_OPEN_CORE_VAULT
mechanism: Cache an OPEN refusal only for an exact canonical core and an exact capability digest.
Capability digest binds canonicalizer, ordered detector portfolio, solver/verifier/policy digests, budgets and protocols.
Reuse requires content verification and replay of the refusal ledger.
Any capability change makes old OPEN logically STALE rather than false or authoritative.
Historical OPEN and a later CLOSED_POLY result may coexist immutably.
high_priority_candidates.prior_art_boundary: Negative caching, theorem-prover proof caches, failed-proof reuse and cache invalidation are established. A current theorem prover such as Naproche-ZF also invalidates proof caches when premises change. The sweep did not find a close standard analogue of exact capability-versioned, proof-carrying negative solver knowledge whose refusal is replayed and automatically becomes stale when solver power changes.
high_priority_candidates.algorithmic_use: Attach it to Debt Kernel as an OPEN_OBLIGATION_VAULT. Swarm agents stop rediscovering the same dead routes under identical capabilities, while new proof rules automatically reopen old cores.
high_priority_candidates.warning: Do not claim novelty until a dedicated ATP/SAT/QBF caching review is completed.

high_priority_candidates.name: ATOMIC_EXTENSION_TO_CERTIFIED_DISCHARGE
high_priority_candidates.mechanism: An auxiliary/extension definition receives zero progress credit and is never accumulated speculatively. It is admissible only inside one atomic macro that immediately performs an exact elimination/reconstruction/debt-discharge step and passes the progress/resource gate.
high_priority_candidates.prior_art_boundary: Extended Resolution, Tseitin extensions, BVA/BVE and structured BVA already introduce auxiliary variables and can reduce formulas; choosing useful extension variables is an established hard search problem. The candidate distinctiveness is not the extension rule, but the admission transaction: EXTEND alone has zero authority; EXTEND+exact discharge must be certified as one macro.
high_priority_candidates.debt_kernel_upgrade: Replace the old syntactic progress_phi by certified semantic progress: an extension macro is accepted only if it closes specified debt or produces an exact carrier transition with bounded liabilities. Fresh aliases cannot increase P(S)=|V_cert|.
high_priority_candidates.expected_benefit: Exploit ER/BVA-like representational power while sharply limiting name explosion and speculative auxiliary-variable pollution.

high_priority_candidates.name: CHARGED_CERTIFICATE_DISCOVERY_AND_DISCHARGE_PROVENANCE

source.line: C026 Certificate Portfolio + C022 honest OBDD + BCEG v9 lifecycle accounting

high_priority_candidates.mechanism: A certificate may discharge scientific/complexity debt only when certificate discovery, language selection, failed candidate attempts, construction, verification and representation materialization are all included in the charged ledger.
high_priority_candidates.prior_art_boundary: Proof automatizability explicitly studies the gap between short proof existence and efficient proof discovery; short Resolution proofs can be hard to find. Therefore discovery-vs-verification is not novel.
high_priority_candidates.distinctive_residue_candidate: Integrate complete discovery provenance directly into the debt-discharge authority: a short certificate cannot retroactively erase expensive search that found it.
high_priority_candidates.algorithmic_use: Use amortized ROI of proof languages and failed-attempt history to train/rank the scheduler without allowing hidden search to masquerade as a polynomial discharge.

high_priority_candidates.name: SEMANTIC_IDENTITY_NE_HISTORICAL_IDENTITY
mechanism: A roundtrip may return to byte-identical/canonical semantic state while transition history remains distinct.
Roundtrip without a receipt is not recovery.
high_priority_candidates.prior_art_boundary: Proof provenance, event sourcing and auditable transition logs are established engineering ideas. No primitive novelty is claimed.
high_priority_candidates.algorithmic_use: Prevents complexity laundering: switch A→B→A cannot reset debt, discovery work or liabilities merely because the semantic representation returned to its old hash.

high_priority_candidates.name: CERTIFIABLE_EQUIVALENCE_AND_PROOF_LANGUAGE_DEBT
mechanism: Semantic equivalence and currently certifiable equivalence are separated.
Two states merge only when the current proof language supplies replayable evidence.
Cross-language negotiation publishes only native certified consequences.
A fixpoint without contradiction is OPEN, never compatibility.
high_priority_candidates.prior_art_boundary: Congruences, partition refinement, abstract interpretation, CEGAR, proof systems and Myhill-Nerode-style state distinctions already cover much of the underlying mathematics.
high_priority_candidates.useful_new_formulation: Track CERTIFICATION_DEBT separately from semantic reconstruction debt: an exact semantic operation may be known/desirable, but until a permitted proof language can certify it, the merge/translation has no authority.
high_priority_candidates.algorithmic_use: Direct the scheduler toward missing bridge certificates instead of repeatedly attacking already-solved local representations.

high_priority_candidates.name: REPRESENTATION_AUTHORITY_FIBER_GATE
high_priority_candidates.mechanism: A compressed representation has semantic authority for target predicate P only if every representation fiber is P-monochromatic; algorithmic authority additionally requires an efficient decider on the representation. A finite absence of collisions is not a universal proof.
high_priority_candidates.prior_art_boundary: Property-specific quotients in abstract interpretation and congruence/sufficient-statistic ideas are established. This is not claimed novel.
high_priority_candidates.algorithmic_use: Make this the mandatory carrier admission gate before any quotient/profile/invariant is permitted into Debt Kernel. It blocks resource statistics or lossy fingerprints from silently becoming semantic state.

high_priority_candidates.name: AMORTIZED_ASCENT_WITH_CERTIFIED_REPAYMENT
high_priority_candidates.mechanism: Permit a non-monotone exact macro whose persisted representation temporarily grows, provided the growth is paid by a certified decrease in another well-founded obligation and a telescoping polynomial envelope is proved.
high_priority_candidates.prior_art_boundary: The potential/accounting method of amortized analysis is classical; weighted potentials are not novelty.
high_priority_candidates.debt_kernel_upgrade: Semantic progress remains DEBT→CERTIFIED. Resource ascent is separately authorized by a proof-carrying liability potential. Do not conflate semantic progress with resource potential.
high_priority_candidates.algorithmic_use: Avoid an overly monotone solver that rejects useful DP/extension moves merely because clauses or literals rise locally.

proposed_integrated_successor.name: JANUS_DUAL_DEBT_CERTIFIED_LIFECYCLE_KERNEL_V0_CANDIDATE
proposed_integrated_successor.state_extension: S_plus = (S_semantic_debt, capability_passport, transformation_debt, certification_debt, discovery_liability, verification_liability, open_vault_refs)
authority_rules: Reversible semantic re-encoding gives zero certified semantic progress.
Deferred exact operation adds TRANSFORMATION_DEBT; compact deferred syntax does not erase future work.
A semantic/certificate discharge may increase certified progress only with local proof plus dependency/domain contract.
Any complexity promotion also requires discovery and verification liabilities to be polynomially discharged.
Representation switches require operation-capability receipts and cannot erase prior liabilities.
Known representation-poison transitions may be rejected pre-materialization by independently checkable lower-bound/capability receipts.
Extension variables have zero progress authority unless admitted inside an atomic exact discharge macro.
OPEN under an exact capability profile is reusable negative knowledge only through refusal-trace replay; capability changes make it stale.
A semantic roundtrip preserves accumulated history/debt/liability even if the semantic hash returns to a previous value.
Scheduler/ML/swarm chooses candidates only; immutable verifier/debt ledgers define authority.
proposed_integrated_successor.why_this_may_advance_the_algorithm: It attacks the frontier left after V1.1 circuit equivalence: not whether a compact witness representation can exist, but whether a uniform solver can discover, switch between, certify and reuse exact representations without hiding exponential work, losing reconstruction obligations, or repeatedly exploring already-refuted routes.
theorem_targets_before_code: DUAL_DEBT_CONSERVATION: semantic debt and transformation/certification liabilities cannot be erased by representation changes.
ATOMIC_EXTENSION_SOUNDNESS: an extension-discharge macro preserves exact source semantics and can increase certified progress only through its discharge proof.
CAPABILITY_SWITCH_SOUNDNESS: every representation switch preserves semantics and transfers all outstanding obligations/liabilities.
OPEN_VAULT_SAFETY: verified OPEN reuse is sound only for identical core+capability and has no semantic SAT/UNSAT authority.
NONFORGETFUL_ROUNDTRIP: semantic identity of start/end states does not cancel intervening charged work or unresolved liabilities.
TERMINAL_LIFECYCLE_THEOREM: zero semantic debt plus zero required transformation/certification liability and exact source replay imply an accepted original-interface terminal.

novelty_assessment.strongest_claim_now: The repository contains a distinctive, internally developed composition of semantic-debt accounting, operation-capability planning, deferred-transformation liability, proof-carrying representation switching, capability-scoped negative knowledge and atomic progress admission. The sweep found public prior art for most primitives but not an obvious single published architecture matching the complete combination.
required_before_external_novelty_claim: Dedicated literature search across SAT/QBF preprocessing, knowledge compilation, proof complexity/automatability, incremental solving, theorem-prover caching and proof-carrying systems.
Search patents/software systems as well as papers for capability-scoped failed-route caching and operation-aware representation switching.
Formalize the integrated state machine independently of historical implementation artifacts.
Benchmark against published synthesis/compilation/proof systems only after the theory contract is frozen.

recommended_priority_order: P0 formalize JANUS_DUAL_DEBT_CERTIFIED_LIFECYCLE_KERNEL without new solver code.
P1 prove nonforgetful debt/liability conservation and terminal soundness.
P2 integrate capability-scoped Open-Core Vault as search-memory, not proof authority.
P3 define atomic EXTEND_AND_DISCHARGE using frozen V1.1 proof rules.
P4 define proof-language/certification-debt handling for cross-language carriers.
P5 only then build a scheduler benchmark comparing route discovery cost against existing BFS/KC/QBF systems.
